definitions.gloss: high school girl, female high school student
definitions.explanation: A female student attending high school. Often abbreviated as JK (じぇーけー) in casual speech and media.

examples.japanese: {女子高生|じょしこうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{歩|ある}いている→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
{女子高生|じょしこうせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦スイーツ→スイーツ：27370_suiitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流行|はや}っている→流行る：02400_hayaru⟧。
examples.english: A new sweet is popular among high school girls.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{放課後|ほうかご}→放課後：12720_houkago⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{女子高生|じょしこうせい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧いっぱい⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
⟦{女子|じょし}→女子：03350_joshi⟧ (female) + {高生|こうせい} (high school student, abbreviation of ⟦{高校生|こうこうせい}→高校生：01580_koukousei⟧).

FORMS:
Commonly abbreviated as JK (じぇーけー) in casual contexts, social media, and marketing. JK⟦{語|ご}→〜語：09841_go⟧ refers to slang used by high school girls.

RELATED WORDS:
- {男子高生|だんしこうせい}: male high school student (abbreviated DK)
- ⟦{女子中学生|じょしちゅうがくせい}→女子中学生：23376_joshichuugakusei⟧: female middle school student
- ⟦{女子大生|じょしだいせい}→女子大生：23937_joshidaisei⟧: female university student

CULTURAL NOTE:
{女子高生|じょしこうせい} are considered trendsetters in Japanese pop culture. Their fashion, slang, and consumer preferences often influence broader trends.
